execution.gaia_adql:
SELECT TOP 5001
        source_id,
        ra,
        ra_error,
        dec,
        dec_error,
        parallax,
        parallax_error,
        pmra,
        pmra_error,
        pmdec,
        pmdec_error,
        phot_g_mean_mag,
        phot_bp_mean_mag,
        phot_rp_mean_mag,
        bp_rp,
        ruwe
    FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
    WHERE CONTAINS(
        POINT('ICRS', ra, dec),
        CIRCLE('ICRS', 80.894, -69.756, 0.03)
    ) = 1
    ORDER BY source_id

interpretation: Agreement with an external algorithm, not ground-truth accuracy.

prior.model: finite-footprint odds scaled by area/(4*pi) for all-sky Bayes factor
